company.name: Refex Industries
company.summary: Ash utilisation, coal-handling services and a wind-turbine business through Venwind Refex.
company.description: Refex Industries provides services around the handling, movement and utilisation of ash and coal at thermal power plants. Its portfolio also includes wind-energy equipment through Venwind Refex. The key distinction is between the operating businesses reported today and older Refex group activities shown in historical material.
company.ownership: This profile covers Refex Industries Limited, not every Refex-branded company. January 2026 results classified power trading, refrigerant gases and green mobility as discontinued operations. Group websites still discuss mobility; check the latest scheme and financial disclosures before mapping ownership.
products: Coal handling plant operations and maintenance
company.money: Core services earn contract-based revenue for handling and moving materials and managing sites. Fleet utilisation, throughput, fuel and equipment costs, customer payments and project execution affect earnings. Wind-equipment orders add a different manufacturing and delivery cycle.
watch: Are new sites and handling volumes converting into profitable work?
Do customer collections keep pace with fleet and operating costs?
Which businesses are continuing, discontinued or subject to restructuring?
risks: Large contracts can make performance sensitive to a few sites and customer decisions.
Safety, environmental obligations, weather and logistics can affect operations.
Changes in the group perimeter and newer manufacturing operations can complicate comparisons.
company.question: Should a historical Refex group business automatically be counted in current Refex Industries revenue?
company.answer: No. Check the listed company’s continuing operations, subsidiaries, disposals and restructuring disclosures for the relevant reporting period.
update: Continuing operations matter more than an old brand list
Power trading and refrigerant-gas activities were classified as discontinued in the January 2026 results. Read newer reports and restructuring updates alongside the group website.
